prompt: Map the YouTube trading-education niche for AlphaTraderTV (stocks + options + crypto, beginner-to-intermediate, US-centric). Identify the top 10 channels driving the niche, dominant vocabulary, trending angles in the last 90 days, seasonal patterns tied to market events, and content gaps where AlphaTraderTV can win.
raw_output:
The YouTube trading-education niche splits into three loosely-overlapping camps: personal-finance lifestyle (Graham Stephan, Andrei Jikh), tactical-execution traders (Benjamin, Bryce Paul, Adam Khoo), and pure crypto (Coin Bureau, Benjamin Cowen). AlphaTraderTV sits closest to the tactical-execution cluster but with stronger options specialization than most.

The top of the niche is dominated by lifestyle channels with 3-6M subs that prioritize broad relatability over execution depth. Below them, the 300k-1.5M tier (Benjamin, Adam Khoo, InTheMoney, Bryce Paul) competes on specificity — real fills, real P&L, named strikes. This is the band AlphaTraderTV is climbing toward, and it's the right reference cohort.

Dominant niche vocabulary clusters around income strategies ('wheel strategy', 'iron condor', 'covered calls', 'cash-secured puts'), market structure ('OPEX', 'gamma squeeze', 'unusual options activity'), and lifestyle proof ('monthly income', 'quit my job', 'options for beginners'). Trending angles the last 90 days: 0DTE options (massive growth Jan-Apr 2026), AI-stock plays (NVDA/AVGO derivatives), and rate-cut positioning. 0DTE specifically is up ~340% in search volume YoY but is dangerous brand territory.

Seasonal patterns are strong and underexploited: tax season (Feb-Apr) spikes 'capital gains', 'tax loss harvesting', 'Roth IRA options' queries; earnings seasons (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) spike single-name strategy searches; OPEX weeks spike 'gamma' and 'pin risk' queries; Fed weeks spike 'rate cut trade' searches. AlphaTraderTV currently publishes flat — no calendar alignment.

Gap observations: (1) almost no channel covers iron-condor monthly P&L with real fills and named strikes; (2) the 'first $1k month from options' beginner-funnel video is missing across the top 10; (3) tax-aware options content is virtually empty space; (4) post-mortem 'I lost money this week' content has high engagement but low supply.

structured_output.niche: Trading Education — Options Income, Equities, Crypto (US, beginner-to-intermediate)

trending_angles.angle: Monthly income breakdowns with real P&L

gap_observations: Monthly iron-condor P&L with real fills is largely empty space
'First $1k month from options' beginner-funnel video missing across top 10
Post-mortem loss-week content has high engagement, low supply
Fed-week positioning playbook content is fragmented and surface-level
